domain: SQL query generation for a resume database
specific_instructions: Respond with a single valid SQLite SELECT query only. No markdown, no explanation — SQL only. Use names exactly as they are stored. If the request includes results from previous steps, copy the exact names from those results into your WHERE clause.
background_context: Schema: institutions(inst_id, type, name, department, address, city, state, zip); positions(position_id, inst_id, title, responsibilities, start_date, end_date); experiences(experience_id, position_id, name, description, hyperlink, start_date, end_date); skills(skill_id, experience_id, name, skill_level)
few_shot_examples:
Q: How many skills do I have? -> SELECT COUNT(*) AS skill_count FROM skills;
Q: What positions did I have at Michigan State University? -> SELECT p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date FROM positions p JOIN institutions i ON p.inst_id = i.inst_id WHERE i.name = 'Michigan State University';
